subject_class: software harnesses that run a frozen bank and grade the outputs

disclosure_bar.rule: presence of at least 3 of 5 link classes

patterns.must_fail_or_negative_control: must.?fail|negative control|expected to fail|control task|canary|tamper|sanity check

frame.inclusion_rule: Every entry in the frozen list was attempted exactly once at run time; none added, dropped, substituted or re-ordered. The grid digest is published.

score_caveat: Bar fixed at the estate's declared 3-of-5 before scoring. The re-frame is declared here as a correction of a frame that could not fail, not as a threshold adjustment.
limitations: A link-class presence check records observable strings in public bytes at observed_at. Absence on the landed URL is not evidence of absence elsewhere.
This measures disclosure presence, not disclosure quality, truth, or compliance.
A refusal is recorded in its own state and is never converted to a zero or a failure.
The frame is a curated list of named harnesses; it is not a probability sample.
